verdict_reason: Removing errorSummaryLink correctly leaves BasePage as its one owner, but two doc comments explain getter names and one is now inaccurate with the roles checkboxes on the form.

todos.issue: The doc comments on form-page.ts:26 ('The form's text inputs in page order.') and :31 ('The label of every field on the form, in page order.') explain the getter names. The :31 comment is also no longer true now the add form has a roles question: fieldLabels returns each checkbox option's label too (addresses-add-handshake.spec.ts:200 expects rolesQuestionLabels.PLACE_OF_ORIGIN in it), and an option is not a field.
todos.fix: Must: neither getter needs a comment, and each name says what it returns. One way: delete both comments and rename fieldLabels to formLabels (every label inside the form, in page order).
